text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Parliametarians seeking a ban on concerts criticise the government. The conservative Gulf Arab state bars dancing parties in compliance with the teachings of Islam, but it allows singers to hold concerts.
- Power problem halts airport functions for 45 minutes on Tuesday.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah expects reconciliation in 1997 with some Arab states that sympathised with Iraq during its 1990-91 occupation of Kuwait.
- Kuwait's gold exports to Dubai rise in 1996.
- Kuwait's ambassador to Egypt says Kuwaiti investments in Egypt are increasing rapidly.
